Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)

```


```{r}
# large_T_antigen__YP_003848919__Human_polyomavirus_6__746830.pdb

# Define span data
chainsaw_spans <- data.frame(Category = 'chainsaw', Start = c(7, 155, 285, 370), End = c(102, 274, 367, 631))
merizo_spans <- data.frame(Category = 'merizo', Start = c(1, 156, 283, 369), End = c(69, 271, 368, 643))
uniprot_spans <- data.frame(Category = 'uniprot', Start = c(154, 280, 393), End = c(271, 370, 571))
ecod_spans <- data.frame(Category = paste0('ecod', 1:7), Start = c(146, 428, 369, 281, 366, 289, 4), End = c(273, 558, 637, 368, 594, 590, 78))
cath_spans <- data.frame(Category = paste0('cath', 1:4), Start = c(369, 369, 277, 397), End = c(594, 636, 368, 646))
cath_ecod_spans2 <- data.frame(Category = 'cath/ecod2', Start = c(281,397), End = c(368,590))
cath_ecod_spans1 <- data.frame(Category = 'cath/ecod1', Start = c(281,369 ), End = c(368,597))

# Combine all data
all_spans <- rbind(uniprot_spans, chainsaw_spans, merizo_spans, ecod_spans, cath_spans, cath_ecod_spans1, cath_ecod_spans2)

all_spans$Category <- factor(all_spans$Category, 
                             levels = c('uniprot', 'chainsaw', 'merizo', 
                                        paste0('ecod', 1:7), paste0('cath', 1:4), 'cath/ecod1', 'cath/ecod2'))

# Define colors for each category
colors <- c(
  'chainsaw' = 'steelblue',
  'merizo' = 'darkorange',
  'uniprot' = 'green',
  'ecod1' = 'red', 'ecod2' = 'red', 'ecod3' = 'red', 'ecod4' = 'red', 'ecod5' = 'red', 'ecod6' = 'red', 'ecod7' = 'red',
  'cath1' = 'purple', 'cath2' = 'purple', 'cath3' = 'purple', 'cath4' = 'purple',
  'cath/ecod1' = 'gray',
  'cath/ecod2' = 'yellow'
)



# Plot the data
ggplot(all_spans, aes(x = Start, xend = End, y = Category, yend = Category, color = Category)) +
  geom_segment(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Start, x = Start), hjust = -0.3, color = 'black', size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = End, x = End), hjust = 1.3, color = 'black', size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = 'Domain Span Visualization: large_T_antigen__YP_003848919',
       x = 'Residue Position',
       y = 'Segmented Domains')


```

#BFLF1__YP_001129444 (agrk)
#Note: CATH and ECOD did not generate any domains with z-score > 8, so none of these are plotted
# also no domains identified by uniprot

chainsaw_spans <- data.frame(Category = 'chainsaw', Start = c(50, 216, 449, 286), End = c(207, 224, 523, 447)) #THERE IS A DISCONTINUOUS DOMAIN HERE
merizo_spans <- data.frame(Category = 'merizo', Start = c(45, 283), End = c(223, 525))
                           
 
# Combine all data
all_spans <- rbind(chainsaw_spans, merizo_spans)

all_spans$Category <- factor(all_spans$Category, 
                             levels = c( 'chainsaw', 'merizo'))

colors <- c(
  'chainsaw' = 'steelblue',
  'merizo' = 'darkorange'
)

# Plot the data
ggplot(all_spans, aes(x = Start, xend = End, y = Category, yend = Category, color = Category)) +
  geom_segment(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Start, x = Start), hjust = -0.3, color = 'black', size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = End, x = End), hjust = 1.3, color = 'black', size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = 'Domain Span Visualization: BFLF1__YP_001129444 ',
       x = 'Position',
       y = 'Category')
